shared_elements: representation of a body/limbs in simplified form
justification: A is a three-dimensional standing figure with a clearly modelled face — brow ridge, nose, eyes, mouth — and arms folded across the chest, whereas B is a faint linear engraving on a flat rock face that reads at most as a small schematic figure or radiating line motif with no discernible facial or bodily detail. The only possible correspondence is that both may depict a highly schematic human form, which is far too generic and too uncertain in B to indicate any shared iconographic scheme; the depiction conventions (volumetric carved head with rendered features vs. thin scratched lines) share nothing specific.
